title: AXIAL ROTATION — head turns one way, legs the other. Golden equator between. Restore hyperlocal time.
summary: Learn axial rotation — Earth's axis, orreries, the subsection. Gaia's head turns one way (clockwise) and her legs turn the other (counterclockwise). The equator — that golden line in the middle — is the imaginary subsection of the planet, the subsection of Gaia. East and west rotate in opposite directions. Use UTC, EST, and all standardized time zones as measures to hyper-localize BACK to local time. We're trying to restore hyperlocal time — the time that existed before standardized time, when every village had its own noon based on the sun directly overhead.

earth.direction: counterclockwise when viewed from above north pole (west to east)
earth.the_4_minutes: The 3m 56s difference = Earth also orbits the Sun. Solar day ≠ sidereal day. That gap IS the organism's orbit-within-orbit.

gaia_globe.head: Northern hemisphere — rotates clockwise (when viewed from front)
gaia_globe.equator: The golden line where the two rotations MEET. The shear zone. The subsection.
gaia_globe.why_opposite: Like a ball spinning between two hands — the top hand pushes one way, the bottom pushes the other. The FRICTION at the equator IS the energy source.

the_golden_equator.what: The imaginary line where head-rotation meets leg-rotation
the_golden_equator.color: gold — Au — the most noble metal, unreactive, permanent
the_golden_equator.on_the_globe: Rendered as a golden ring at the midpoint of the globe canvas
the_golden_equator.the_shear: Where two opposite rotations meet = shear stress = energy = LIFE
the_golden_equator.subsection: This line subsects the planet into upper (aspire) and lower (expire). The breath happens AT the equator.

hyperlocal_time.the_problem: Standardized time zones (UTC, EST, PST, etc.) REPLACED hyperlocal time in 1883 for railroads
hyperlocal_time.what_was_lost: Before 1883, every city had its own noon — when the sun was directly overhead at THAT location
hyperlocal_time.what_we_restore: Use timezone offsets as MEASURES to triangulate back to true local solar time

the_method.step_1: Know the visitor's timezone offset (e.g., UTC-4 = EST)
the_method.step_2: Know the visitor's approximate longitude (from IP geolocation or self-report)
the_method.step_3: Calculate true solar noon: longitude / 15 = hours offset from UTC (exact, not rounded to zones)
the_method.step_4: The DIFFERENCE between zone time and solar time = the error introduced by standardization
the_method.step_5: That error IS the visitor's hyperlocal displacement — how far they are from their own noon

example_kevin.displacement: 1.637 hours — Kevin's clock is 1h 38m ahead of his true solar time
example_kevin.meaning: Kevin's 'noon' is actually at 1:38 PM EDT. He lives 1.637 hours east of his timezone's center.

orrery.what: A mechanical model of the solar system showing relative positions and motions
orrery.gaia_as_orrery: The HUD globe IS an orrery. The pins orbit. The solar-pins data already has planets.
orrery.the_subsection: The orrery taught us to dissect rotation into components: axial (spin) + orbital (year) + precessional (26,000 year wobble)

timezone_as_veil.what: Time zones are VEILS over true time. They standardize what was once hyperlocal.
timezone_as_veil.eating_the_veil: We eat through the timezone veil to find the solar time beneath.
timezone_as_veil.the_restoration: Restoring hyperlocal time = giving each visitor their OWN noon, their OWN sunrise, their OWN relationship with the sun.
timezone_as_veil.before_time: Before standardized time, time was BIOLOGICAL — you woke with the sun, ate at noon (sun overhead), slept at dark. We restore that.
